comment: Lofted Flange (mitcad#2512; tools/ui-sheet-lofted-flange-test.sh and its Windows and macOS twins): sheet rules F1 (t = 2, K = 0.5), Sketch F2 on XY with a rectangle 120 x 80 about the origin, Plane F3 70 up and Sketch F4 on it with a circle of radius 30 about the axis: the press brake transition with 4 facets a corner is cli.sheet_lofted_flange's F9 (44583.220053535406 mm3).
